address: 40 Charoen Muang Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50000, Thailand
bio: A recent addition to downtown Chiang Mai's dining scene, this vegetarian eatery channels the spirit of Mae Tang. In a charming 100-year-old Colonial Lanna house, green walls and cotton flags make for a serene and calming space. The veteran chef brings Buddhist philosophy to a deep understanding of ingredients, crafting MSG- free dishes that are rich in natural umami. Don't miss the pad thai with banana-flour noodles – tender, saucy and truly one of a kind....
